test_item:
Export certificate
(ECU certificate is exported to a file)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. An ECU certificate is present on the DUT
proc:
1. Export the ECU certificate file from the DUT to the host
$ adb pull /data/misc/ecuidentity/ecu.crt
2. Check the exported certificate on the host
$ openssl x509 -in ecu.crt -noout -text
er:
1. The adb pull command reports "1 file pulled" and ecu.crt is present on the host
2. The openssl output shows an "Issuer:" line and a "Subject:" line for the ECU certificate
design: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
